svg.title: nBROWSER: Network Admission and Compact Web Evidence
svg.desc: Four-stage architectural pipeline showing network egress validation, fast static extraction, isolated browser execution, and compact evidence output.

g.text: nBROWSER: Network Admission and Compact Web Evidence
Deterministic egress isolation, zero-Chromium fast extraction, ephemeral sandboxing, and cited evidence capture
Bound strictly to scheme + host + port
Prevents token leakage to third parties
HTTP status, TLS cipher, error logs
